$comment: Generated by scripts/schemas from trialfolio.contracts.report_manifest.ReportManifest, in serialization mode. Validation and serialization modes give the same schema. Never edit it by hand.

AnalysisSetMethod.description:
The analysis set a manifest's `analysis.csv` holds the values of, by its version, a string,
as `analysis.csv`'s `analysis_set` gives it.
AnalysisSetMethod.title: AnalysisSetMethod

BaselineComparisonMethod.description:
`baseline-comparison`, the rules of comparing a case with the baseline, by its version, an
integer, as a review's method's is. A change to them that could change a row of
`comparison.csv` makes a new version.
BaselineComparisonMethod.title: BaselineComparisonMethod

ParserVersion.description: The parser version applied to one provider response layout.
ParserVersion.title: ParserVersion

ReportArtifact.description: One file `trialfolio report` wrote, by path, content address, and role.

schema_version.description: A table's schema version; null for the report, which has none.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

ReportArtifact.title: ReportArtifact

ReportCapabilities.description:
What the output does and doesn't contain. It holds no response, so a series it holds is
one it normalized.

return_series.description: `normalized` exactly when the output holds a `series.csv`.
return_series.title: Return Series

ReportCapabilities.title: ReportCapabilities

ReportInput.description:
What the report renders: a saved run, or a saved experiment's latest session, named by the
`artifact_id` of the run's or the session's `manifest.json`, and its plan's hash. No path.

manifest.description: The `artifact_id` of the run's `manifest.json`, or of the session's.
manifest.title: Manifest

plan_hash.description: The run's plan's hash, or the session's current plan's.
plan_hash.title: Plan Hash

experiment_id.description: The experiment's identity; null for a run.
experiment_id.title: Experiment Id

session.description:
The number of the session whose report it renders, the latest manifest's; null for a
run.
session.title: Session

ReportInput.title: ReportInput

description:
The manifest `trialfolio report` writes last: what it rendered, the tables it calculated,
and the methods and parsers behind the values its report shows.

trialfolio_version.description: The version that rendered the report.
trialfolio_version.title: Trialfolio Version

synthetic.description: As the input's manifest gives it.
synthetic.title: Synthetic

artifacts.description:
`report.html`, then each table it wrote, in the order it wrote them. Not the input's
files, which its manifest lists and the report links, and not `logs/`.
artifacts.title: Artifacts

parsers.description:
The parser version that read each response for a `series.csv` it wrote, with its layout's
version; empty when it wrote none.
parsers.title: Parsers

methods.description:
Each method whose values the report shows: `analysis-set`, with each version of the
`analysis.csv` it shows, the input's or its own, and, for an experiment, then
`baseline-comparison`, version 1.
methods.title: Methods

title: ReportManifest
